notices.dialog.title: Notices
notices.topic.headline: Notices
notices.topic.intro: Notes that came with updates. Unread ones open by themselves when the app starts; once you mark one read it stops appearing, in every window of this device.
notices.topic.readOnly: This window cannot mark notices read. Open this list on the device they belong to.
notices.item.multiDevice.title: Bakabase across your devices
notices.item.multiDevice.body: Every computer running the desktop app is now a Bakabase server of its own, and the devices on your network can reach one another.
notices.item.multiDevice.point.library: Multi-device library searches this computer and the devices that share with it, and lists everything in one place.
notices.item.multiDevice.point.switch: Switch this window to a NAS or another computer you manage, and control it as if you were sitting in front of it.
notices.item.thinClient.title: Bakabase Client is discontinued
notices.item.thinClient.body: The separate Bakabase Client app is no longer updated. The desktop app does its job now: switch this window to any server you manage and control it fully.
notices.item.thinClient.point.imported: Servers Bakabase Client was paired with on this computer are brought over automatically, keys and path mappings included, so nothing has to be paired again.
notices.item.thinClient.point.otherCompu: Using Bakabase Client on another computer? Install the desktop app there; it brings that client's servers over the same way.
notices.item.thinClient.point.uninstall: Once the servers appear under Devices you manage, Bakabase Client can be uninstalled.
